slice: weather forecast atomic persistence and projection
implementation: Forecast row insert errors now propagate to the location transaction boundary.
Each location's forecast batch is protected by a PostgreSQL savepoint, so a failed row rolls back the complete location batch.
Successful and failed ingestion audit rows use the same PostgreSQL connection and transaction as forecast persistence and the ClickHouse outbox.
Only a successfully persisted location batch is added to the ClickHouse projection payload.
Transactional outbox enqueue failures propagate, prevent commit, and close the connection so PostgreSQL rolls back source, audit, and outbox state together.
